description:
Make forage-ctl pick/ssh work for Apple runtime by using exec-based attach instead of SSH.

Apple Container uses vmnet with different IPs and has no SSH daemon. The fix:
- ssh/pick commands detect runtime capabilities and use ExecInteractive when SSHAccess=false
- Multiplexer session is started post-creation for OCI runtimes (not just nspawn)

```mermaid
graph LR
    1[exec-based attach] --> 2[mux init post-create]
```
title: Exec-based connectivity for Apple Container runtime
